title: Will Housewife by Tate McRae debut #1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
rules: If Housewife by Tate McRae is #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart for the Week of Oct 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: This market and these products have not been endorsed by Billboard. Any references to "Billboard", the "Hot 100," or any other associated marks are descriptive only, and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Billboard and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Tate McRae has never had a Hot 100 #1; her best singles ('Greedy', 'Tit for Tat') peaked at #3. 'Housewife' releases Thursday Oct 15, so the Oct 31 chart is likely its first full tracking week. It must beat Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas', which has repeatedly reclaimed #1, plus any new big-star releases. A lead single for a hyped new era, extra versions for sale and Victoria's Secret show exposure give it a real but minority chance.
blind.falsifier: Billboard's chart dated Oct 31, 2026 shows 'Housewife' at #1 (e.g., after a big first-week streaming total plus strong sales of extra versions while 'Choosin' Texas' fades and no major release competes).

final.reasoning: My 13% is close to the 15% midpoint, and the 9–21 cent spread means buying NO at about 91 cents would exceed my roughly 87% NO probability. The market price doesn't change my view that she probably falls short against 'Choosin' Texas' given her #3 career peak.
